advice_items.quote: you are under no obligation to be the same person you were yesterday. You can go off. You can change. You can do something different.
advice_items.summary_en: You are not bound by who you were yesterday; embrace change and prove doubters wrong.
advice_items.summary_zh: 不被过往定义，敢于转型并证明质疑者错了

advice_items.quote: when you're selling a company, you want to be able to sell the company that doesn't have you attached to it. And I think what I did wrong... is I would remove myself as part of the company.
advice_items.summary_en: Remove yourself from daily operations and brand attachment before selling so you avoid key-man risk.
advice_items.summary_zh: 卖公司前先去个人化，消除关键人物风险

advice_items.quote: Don't put all your eggs in one basket. So, make sure that you diversify your wealth... investing in property, investing in the market, like just diversifying your wealth
advice_items.summary_en: Diversify your wealth across cash-flowing property, gas stations, and financial markets instead of keeping everything in one basket.
advice_items.summary_zh: 别把鸡蛋放一个篮子，多元配置房产与市场

advice_items.quote: you're under no obligation to be the same person you were yesterday. You can make a change. If you have a passion, go for it.
advice_items.summary_en: If you have a passion for something, pursue it boldly and allow yourself to evolve.
advice_items.summary_zh: 只要心怀热爱，就果断去尝试做出改变

guests.first_money_or_break: 早年在父母后院从私人教练起步，完全自筹资金（bootstrapped）创办健身应用 Sweat，最终以 4 亿美元出售。
guests.role_or_title: Founder of Sweat App / Former Personal Trainer
guests.wealth_detail: Sold Sweat app for $400M (bootstrapped without investors)
guests.zero_start_advice: 不要被过去的身份或家人朋友的质疑束缚，有热情就勇敢转型；如果未来想出售公司，务必提前消除“关键人物风险”把个人与公司解绑，赚到钱后把资产分散配置到物业和市场中。

advice_items.quote: I ended up in the space because I loved what I did, right? I love the smell of diesel in the morning. Every morning for me was like Christmas morning.
advice_items.summary_en: Love your craft even in an unglamorous industry and wake up excited to compete every day.
advice_items.summary_zh: 真正热爱所做的传统行业，每天充满干劲

advice_items.quote: What makes him better than the next guy? It's how much you put into it... every morning getting up, every night coming home late.
advice_items.summary_en: Stand out by outworking everyone—show up early, stay late, and go to work every single day.
advice_items.summary_zh: 成功取决于投入程度，每天早出晚归死磕

advice_items.quote: we needed land and we bought a lot of land. Now today, we have over a thousand tenants in all of our real estate.
advice_items.summary_en: Buy land and income-producing real estate consistently alongside your operating business to build generational wealth.
advice_items.summary_zh: 围绕主业持续囤地买房，打造千名租客资产

advice_items.canonical_tag: Use Debt Wisely (Good Debt vs Bad Debt)
advice_items.quote: Don't have debt. I'm a debt-free operator, right? So, that's key because if there's a mistake, you can rebound. And a lot of guys leverage all the debt up... they're so broke because they're leveraged up.
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid heavy leverage and operate debt-free (only financing core equipment like trucks you keep for 10 years) so you can survive mistakes and keep exit proceeds.
advice_items.summary_zh: 坚持零负债稳健经营，不被高杠杆拖垮

advice_items.quote: If you got the discipline to go to the gym every single day and take care of yourself, it starts right here.
advice_items.summary_en: Physical fitness and daily gym discipline directly reinforce the mental discipline required for financial success.
advice_items.summary_zh: 保持每天健身自律，身体纪律决定事业高度

advice_items.quote: When I sold my business two months later, I had a massive heart attack... my survival rate in the hospital was 11%... You want to wake up? That's a wakeup call.
advice_items.summary_en: Stay grounded in faith and remember that surviving major health crises puts life and success in perspective.
advice_items.summary_zh: 经历鬼门关后更加笃信信仰，懂得感恩敬畏

advice_items.quote: I got a third grade education. I'm not a schooled guy... Because I know I was better than that and I know what I wanted and I was going to go for it.
advice_items.summary_en: Do not let limited formal education or doubters stop you from pursuing what you know you can achieve.
advice_items.summary_zh: 学历低也绝不听信质疑，坚定追求心中目标

advice_items.quote: Be 10 minutes early to everything you do. Think about tomorrow cuz it's going to come... you're thinking about Thursday and you're thinking out in 5-year plans
advice_items.summary_en: Always arrive 10 minutes early and run your life ahead of schedule with 5-year forward plans.
advice_items.summary_zh: 凡事提前十分钟到场，提前做五年长远规划

guests.first_money_or_break: 从小送报纸、割草、做砍树生意起家，之后用 68 美元应收账款、两辆卡车和空仓库接手父亲的小生意，服务财富100强客户并零负债做大，最终以超 5 亿美元出售物流公司并转型拥有逾千名租客的商业地产。
guests.guest_name: NYC Trucking & Commercial Real Estate Founder
guests.role_or_title: Former Trucking & Logistics Owner / Commercial Real Estate Investor
guests.wealth_detail: Sold trucking/logistics company for over $500M (debt-free); owns real estate with over 1,000 tenants
guests.zero_start_advice: 别找借口，每天全力以赴去干；保持零负债或极低杠杆，避免踩坑翻车；坚持每天健身自律，凡事提前10分钟到场并用5年长远视角规划人生。

advice_items.canonical_tag: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep
advice_items.quote: I just let it sit. I really worked off my endorsement money. I didn't really touch my game money.
advice_items.summary_en: Live off secondary/endorsement income and leave your primary earnings untouched so you avoid going broke.
advice_items.summary_zh: 只花代言收入，绝不动用比赛薪水本金

advice_items.quote: Gratitude is the key to abundance and hard work and never giving up.
advice_items.summary_en: Combine gratitude with relentless hard work and refusal to quit to sustain long-term career longevity.
advice_items.summary_zh: 靠感恩心态、努力拼搏与永不放弃保持长青

advice_items.quote: my dad, he told me like the three rules of life, that's God, that's education, and you could do anything you put your mind to.
advice_items.summary_en: Anchor yourself in faith, education, and the belief that you can accomplish anything you set your mind to.
advice_items.summary_zh: 牢记信仰、教育与坚定信念：心之所向皆可成

advice_items.quote: My faith in God helped me to endure and go through anything that I experienced along the way... how can you be an influence? How can you impact someone else to serve a high calling
advice_items.summary_en: Rely on faith during fear or doubt and focus on how you can positively impact others for a higher purpose.
advice_items.summary_zh: 以信仰为根基扛过恐惧质疑，服务更高使命

guests.first_money_or_break: 21 岁通过 NFL 选秀进入联盟并成为百万富翁，巅峰单年收入达 2500 万美元，凭借只花代言费、不动比赛薪水的自律方式积累家族财富。
guests.wealth_detail: $25M single-year peak income; became a millionaire at age 21; 11-year NFL career
guests.zero_start_advice: 保持感恩、努力工作并永不放弃，依靠信仰度过恐惧与自我怀疑，赚到大钱后只动用副业或代言收入，把核心大额收入存下来建立跨代财富。

advice_items.quote: it's tough. It's not as glamorous as like my eyes are bloodshot. You don't sleep much. It's not that sexy... I'm not the best. I just work really hard.
advice_items.summary_en: Recognize that entrepreneurship is exhausting and unglamorous, and outwork others even if you are not the smartest or best negotiator.
advice_items.summary_zh: 创业并不光鲜而是睡眠不足，唯靠拼命工作

advice_items.quote: when I got arrested that takes the ego out of your life... when I was younger I was like cocky and arrogant and I paid the price.
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid youthful arrogance and unchecked ego—losing everything teaches humility the hard way.
advice_items.summary_zh: 年轻时狂妄自大付出惨痛代价，跌倒才懂谦卑

advice_items.canonical_tag: Use Debt Wisely (Good Debt vs Bad Debt)
advice_items.quote: I was really overleveraged in the beginning. It was a total shit show... leverage is part of the growth. But at this point in my life that I'm older, the leverage days are over.
advice_items.summary_en: Bank loans and leverage can fuel early growth, but over-leverage is brutal—pay it down and shed debt as you mature.
advice_items.summary_zh: 早期靠杠杆起步，但成熟后要果断远离负债

advice_items.quote: Get a magnifying glass before you sign that stuff. And definitely don't sign anything without having somebody look over it... When you guarantee something, you're liable.
advice_items.summary_en: Read every line of fine print on bank loans and contracts and always have an advisor review them before signing personal guarantees.
advice_items.summary_zh: 签贷款合同必用放大镜看小字并找人把关

advice_items.quote: we all have bad stuff happen but you can't just feel sorry for yourself. You got to keep pushing through... you have to save yourself. No one's going to fix it.
advice_items.summary_en: Never feel sorry for yourself when hitting rock bottom; take full responsibility, save yourself, and keep pushing forward.
advice_items.summary_zh: 遭遇低谷别自怨自艾，唯有自己能拯救自己

advice_items.quote: You just got to stay focused and you got to sacrifice... I try not to even put myself in situations that I have to make that [bad] choice.
advice_items.summary_en: Stay laser-focused, make sacrifices, and deliberately avoid putting yourself in situations where you might make bad choices.
advice_items.summary_zh: 保持专注并学会牺牲，远离诱发错误的情境

advice_items.quote: never believe your own hype... money is a mirage. My biggest strength is I can be happy with nothing... I don't need fancy cars. I don't need jets... if that drives your happiness, it's not sustainable.
advice_items.summary_en: Never believe your own hype or tie your happiness to jets, fancy cars, and watches—learn to be happy with nothing.
advice_items.summary_zh: 别轻信自身光环，物质豪车无法带来持久幸福

advice_items.quote: our problems are so little compared to other people's problems. So, I just appreciate what I have every day.
advice_items.summary_en: Keep perspective on how small your problems are compared to others and practice daily gratitude for family and life.
advice_items.summary_zh: 常怀感恩珍惜当下，莫让欲望超越内心满足

guests.first_money_or_break: 早期靠向银行贷款起步，从事废旧汽车粉碎与金属回收生意近 40 年，期间曾因违规操作被捕并服刑一年，出狱后从谷底专注重建，将公司做到年入 6000 万至 7000 万美元、估值约 10 亿美元。
guests.role_or_title: Scrap Metal & Junk Car Shredding CEO / Founder
guests.wealth_detail: Company worth ~$1B; peak annual earnings of $60M-$70M
guests.zero_start_advice: 创业早期可以用杠杆但不要过度负债，签任何贷款和担保合同前都要仔细看清小字并找专业人士审核；陷入谷底时别自怨自艾，专注并做出牺牲，也不要让自己处于可能犯错的境地；成功之后别相信外界对你的吹捧，学会在物质之外寻找幸福。
